mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.email_activation_tokens( token_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{tokenId}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT token_id AS tokenId, user_id AS userId, token_hash AS tokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, used_at AS usedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM public.email_activation_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND used_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} LIMIT 1
